tips.text: Look for the yellow Point of Interest marker on the outpost; the white markers from Piloting rank 5 are derelicts that never drop Oberon.
Split the squad: one player boards the outpost while the rest, or AI gunners, kill the fighters.
Use Tactical Intrinsic rank 4 Recall Warp to teleport back to the Railjack after you open the cache.
Bring a human partner for outpost radiators; AI crew shoot them poorly and a solo player can stall.
Skip drop chance boosters; they do nothing for cache rolls.
Clear both yellow objectives before killing the last fighters and crewships, or the mission ends before you roll the cache.
Expect about ten caches per part, and up to about 65 on bad luck.
Players call Railjack mildly annoying rather than hard, and most rate the Circuit week 5 route as the calmest option.
